introduction_title: Meet as strangers, leave as friends.
introduction_subtitle: Couchers.org is a community and platform built to facilitate genuine interaction between travelers and locals, centered around <bold>couch surfing</bold>—free, non-transactional homestays and meetups. Our global community is based on meaningful and inclusive cultural exchange while prioritizing trust and safety.
signup_description: Travel, host, and connect with {{ user_count }} members
what_couchsurfing_description: Couchers.org is an open, community-led platform built by travelers, for travelers - not investors. We're a non-profit organization committed to keeping travel human, accessible, and genuine. Whether you're hosting visitors from around the world or looking for a place to stay on your next adventure, or build a local community where travellers from all the world can take part, Couchers.org helps you connect safely and meaningfully.
sign_up_ready: Sign up and you are ready to go!
community_first_description: We believe travel is about real connections. As a non-profit, we're guided by our members - not profits or outside investors. Your voice matters here.
safer_stronger_description: We've reimagined trust and safety with a new approach to references, verification, and accountability, so you can focus on meeting great people.
built_by_travelers_description: With a team of over 40 volunteers - travelers, hosts, and developers - we're building a platform that's stable, modern, and made for how people actually travel today.
